title: RagHarnessDebugger: Jev-Guided Agentic RAG in Contract Inference Repair Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2611.22991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic systems using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must repair their own answers by gathering more evidence, testing alternative policies and deciding if, when, and what repairs are needed. Yet how do we know if a system's repairs are working when metrics like accuracy can be misleading? We present RagHarnessDebugger, a framework that records every repair decision in a Jev-guided harness for contract inference and audits the record to facilitate complete debugging of all decisions taken during a RAG repair journey. RagHarnessDebugger checks that each trace is intact, that each validation applies to the candidate it is counted for, and which answers the acceptance rule can reach. We tested our approach on ContractNLI non-disclosure agreements with two reader models and a replication set of separate contracts. Our debugger's audit layer exposed failure patterns that were hidden under aggregate metrics, policies acceptance cost of r

translated_title: RagHarnessDebugger：契约推理修复审计中基于Jev引导的智能体RAG框架
translated_abstract: 使用检索增强生成（RAG）的智能体系统必须通过收集更多证据、测试替代策略，并决定是否、何时以及需要何种修复来自行修正其答案。然而，当准确率等指标可能具有误导性时，我们如何知道系统的修复是否真正有效？我们提出了RagHarnessDebugger，这是一个在Jev引导的测试框架中记录契约推理的每一个修复决策，并对这些记录进行审计的框架，从而能够对RAG修复过程中采取的所有决策进行完整调试。RagHarnessDebugger检查每条轨迹是否完整、每个验证是否适用于其所统计的候选对象，以及接受规则能够覆盖哪些答案。我们在ContractNLI保密协议任务上使用两个阅读器模型以及一组独立合同构成的复现集对我们的方法进行了测试。我们的调试器审计层暴露了隐藏在聚合指标之下的失败模式，以及策略接受成本方面的…
tldr: 提出了RagHarnessDebugger框架，通过Jev引导的测试工具记录并审计智能体RAG在契约推理修复过程中的全部决策，从而暴露出被准确率等聚合指标所掩盖的失败模式。
en_tdlr: RagHarnessDebugger records and audits every repair decision in a Jev-guided agentic RAG harness for contract inference, exposing failure patterns hidden beneath aggregate metrics such as accuracy.
